Container.Name: FamilyChristmas
Container.Overview: Family wishlists, gift shopping and Secret Santa in one private website. Everyone makes a wishlist (paste a store link and it fills itself in), family members mark gifts as bought without the recipient ever seeing, and an organizer runs a Secret Santa draw with anonymous messages. Works as an installable phone app with notifications. First start: open the WebUI and create the admin account using the setup code shown in this container's log.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: christmas wishlist wish list gift secret santa family holiday
Container.Requires: For the phone app and notifications, put it behind a reverse proxy with https (e.g. Nginx Proxy Manager or SWAG) and set Public URL. Email settings are needed for invites, reminders and password resets.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database, photos and generated keys. Back this up (Appdata Backup plugin). A pool path such as /mnt/cache/appdata/familychristmas is best for the database.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The address your family uses, e.g. https://wishlist.example.com - used for links in emails and notifications.

Config.Name: Behind a reverse proxy
Config.Description: true if people reach it through Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG, Cloudflare Tunnel etc. (so sign-in limits see each visitor's real address). Leave false if they connect to this port directly.

Config.Name: Mail username
Config.Description: SMTP login, e.g. your Gmail address.

Config.Name: Mail password
Config.Description: SMTP password (for Gmail, an App Password).

Config.Name: Gemini API key
Config.Description: Optional: Google Gemini key for smarter link lookups, photo characters and gift poems.

Config.Name: Reminder hour
Config.Description: Hour of the day (0-23) reminder emails go out.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: Optional: postgresql://user:password@host:5432/dbname to use PostgreSQL. Leave empty for the built-in SQLite file in appdata.

Config.Name: SQLite journal mode
Config.Description: delete (safe anywhere) or wal (faster; only when Appdata is a pool path like /mnt/cache/..., not /mnt/user/...).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the appdata files.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the appdata files.
